creative_direction: Create a youthful Nezuko Kamado portrait with long dark hair, warm hair ends, and a small familiar side ribbon. She adjusts the ribbon gently with one hand near her ear, keeping the fingers away from the eyes. Her mouth is visible and free, forming a soft natural smile. Use a modest pale pink everyday robe with a fully covering neckline. Build the image from graphic mint, cream, and muted rose planes, with a few dark hair sections rather than many strands. Preserve her natural age and simple styling. The head and shoulders remain centered with space. Use gentle rose-violet concentric iris rings around clear dark pupils, with bright catchlights. A pale moon disc sits behind the portrait as a quiet background shape, suggesting Infinite Tsukuyomi without changing the expression. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
